ownerStatement: Approve this exact experimental update with the limits disclosed
reason: The owner approved Scale Quantizer 0.1.5-experimental source 931d9cd97feb3e46a9ac0d72581d7587980d92d0e9cd9838cc38ae479a66e8d1 (#1886), which drops the two panel sites so FM Synth can later install beside it. The author ran package 092a8a13 on his MKI on base 0.7.12 (254c5a75): the upgrade from 0.1.4, FOLLOW from audio and MIDI, and the saved scale after a power cycle passed, and the one-step SCALE drop the owner asked about did not reproduce (TESTING.md). The package rebuilds byte-identical on base 0.8.1. Its cost at rest was not measured again (0.1.4 read 0 points; 0.1.5 has fewer hooks), nothing ran on base 0.8 or an MKII, and chip timing and complete memory bounds remain unmeasured. FM Synth 0.1.5 still declares a conflict with it, so players cannot install the two together yet.
